title: Bank Transaction Anomaly
scenario: Flag transactions that are more than 3 standard deviations away from the user's average transaction amount.
hint: Use AVG() OVER and STDDEV() OVER to compute the threshold.
correctQuery: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, AVG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id) as mu, STDDEV(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id) as sigma FROM transactions) t WHERE ABS(amount - mu) > 3 * sigma;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE transactions (user_id INT, amount NUMERIC);
